source: NCERT Class XI, India Physical Environment, Ch. 1 (India — Location).

sections.heading: 1. India's Location and Extent
points: India lies entirely in the **Northern and Eastern Hemispheres**; latitudinal extent **8°4'N to 37°6'N**, longitudinal **68°7'E to 97°25'E**.
The **Tropic of Cancer (23°30'N)** passes through the middle of India (through 8 states).
India is the **seventh largest** country in the world (area ~3.28 million sq km, ~2.4% of world land area) and **second most populous**.

sections.heading: 2. Standard Meridian and Time
points: The **Standard Meridian of India = 82°30'E**, passing through **Mirzapur (Uttar Pradesh)** → **Indian Standard Time (IST)** is **5 hours 30 minutes ahead of GMT**.
The east–west extent (~30° longitude) causes ~2 hours of local time difference between Arunachal Pradesh and Gujarat — hence a single standard time was adopted.

sections.heading: 3. India and the World / Neighbours
points: India has a **central location** on the head of the **Indian Ocean** — commanding trade routes between Europe/Africa and East Asia; the Indian Ocean is named after India.
The **Deccan Peninsula** juts into the Indian Ocean, aiding maritime contact.
**Land neighbours:** Pakistan, Afghanistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, Bangladesh; **island/maritime neighbours:** Sri Lanka and Maldives.
Contact with the world via ancient land and sea routes spread Indian culture, spices, ideas (e.g. to SE Asia).

sections.heading: 4. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Tropic of Cancer (23°30'N) divides India roughly in half.
Standard Meridian = 82°30'E (through Mirzapur, UP); IST = GMT + 5:30.
India = 7th largest country; 2.4% of world land area.
Land neighbours: Pakistan, Afghanistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, Bangladesh; sea: Sri Lanka, Maldives.

sections.heading: 5. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: The **Tropic of Cancer (23°30'N)** passes through the middle of India.
India is the **7th largest** country by area.
**Sri Lanka and Maldives** are India's **island/maritime** neighbours.
